EmailTemplate.subject: Host a Blood Drive. Helping Sickle Cell Patients in Need.
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi [NAME]
I wanted to reach out to you today, as a valued member of the Black community, My name is <NAME> and I am an American Red Cross Account Manager.
African American blood donors play a critical role in helping patients battling sickle cell disease to receive the most compatible blood match. Today, there aren’t enough African American donors to meet this urgent need.
Answer the call to help save those suffering from diseases, such as sickle cell, by partnering with the Red Cross to host a blood drive and collect the most compatible blood for to help support over 100,000 sickle cell patients and families.
Our Blood Saves Lives!
Let’s find time to talk. Please call me at <XXX_XXX_XXXX> or email me at <email address> so I can introduce myself and talk about a blood drive at your organization.
Sincerely, [NAME]
